newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Mari Gas finds major reserve.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Mari Gas finds major reserve.

text.p: Mari Gas Company Limited (MGCL) said on Monday it had found a major natural gas reserve of probably 1.25 trillion cubic feet in Pakistan's southern province of Sindh, the official APP news agency said on Monday.
APP said MGCL's discovery, in Sindh's Ghotki district, flowed at a rate of 24 million cubic feet per day.

"Based on the completion of this deep well, the tentatively proven gas reserve from the tested intervals is approximately four billion cubic feet and the probable reserves are approximated at 1.25 trillion cubic feet," MGCL said. "It is, therefore, expected to be a substantive discovery of gas in the country."
